newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Mobil Corp enters deals with Bangladeshi company.
newsitem.headline: Mobil Corp enters deals with Bangladeshi company.

text.p: U.S. oil company Mobil Corp has entered into an agreement with Bangladesh's Jamuna Oil Company Ltd (JOCL) to market lube oil, JOCL officials said on Wednesday.
They said under an agreement signed here on Tuesday, JOCL would start blending and selling Mobil lube oil on July 1.

The officials said Mobil and JOCL were likely to form a joint venture company to set up a liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) bottling plant, a lube oil blending plant, grease plant and lube oil packaging plant near the southeastern port city of Chittagong.
The officials said the proposed joint venture company would initially invest 1.2 billion taka on projects designed to market 50,000 tonnes of bottled LPG and blend 20,000 tonnes of lube oil annually.
They said Bangladesh produced only 15,000 tonnes of LPG against an annual demand for 200,000 tonnes, and 24,000 tonnes of lube oil against a demand for 40,000 tonnes.
